content.text:
Perfect! I can see:
- `FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS` has `BEN_RES_REG` (beneficiary residence region) and `PRS_REM_MNT` (reimbursement amount)
- `DIM_REGION` has the region codes and their labels

Let me check the data to understand what we're working with:

input.sql:
SELECT 
  dr.BEN_RES_REG,
  dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB,
  SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.BEN_RES_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG, dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY dr.BEN_RES_REG

content.text: Great! I can see the data includes an "Inconnu" (Unknown) region with code 99. Now I have all the information I need. Let me format the final query to return the region names and total reimbursed amounts:

input.final_sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB, 'Inconnu') as region_name,
  SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.BEN_RES_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
